issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'בְּכֹל עֲבַר נַהֲרָה' means 'over all the region beyond the River' (i.e., the province Beyond the River, a specific administrative region), not '在一切過河處' ('at all crossing places of the river'). The Chinese rendering misinterprets the geographic term 'עֲבַר נַהֲרָה' (Beyond the River) as a generic phrase about crossing points, changing the meaning of the verse.
